title: 15th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President has returned for reconsideration the 5th Amendment Bill to the Maldives Courts Act (Law No. 22/2010), which the Majlis had passed and sent for ratification under Article 91(a) of the Constitution.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Kingdom of Denmark, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of advising the President on removing the Deputy Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81) is sent to the relevant standing committee under Rule 232(b) of the Standing Orders.
From the Speaker's desk: the proposal by Ihavandhoo MP Ahmed Naseer to amend the Majlis Standing Orders under Rule 272(c) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

National Security Services Committee report on the names of members of the public who applied, in response to the Majlis Secretariat's announcement, for the two public seats on the Police Board that the Majlis appoints under Article 75(d) of the Maldives Police Service Act (Law No. 34/2020).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting received the President's veto of the Courts Act amendment, sent the Denmark ambassador nomination, the MMA Deputy Governor removal and a Standing Orders change to committees, and took up the committee report on Police Board public seats.
